faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Still Have Questions?
faq.desc: We've collected the most common questions from new users to help you decide if AgentSkills is right for you.
faq.q1: Does it cost anything to join AgentSkills?
faq.a1: No. Browsing skills, registering an account, and submitting basic feedback are all free. You only need to invest time and expertise to earn corresponding reputation records.
faq.q2: Can I participate without a technical background?
faq.a2: Absolutely. You can discover and rate skills as a user; if you have business experience, you can also submit feedback from a practical application perspective. Technical and non-technical reviews are equally valuable.
faq.q3: What do I get after publishing a skill?
faq.a3: Your skill is indexed in a searchable library and discovered by more users. After verification, it earns reputation bonuses that increase your visibility and trustworthiness in the ecosystem.
faq.q4: What is reputation actually good for?
faq.a4: Reputation is your credibility credential in this ecosystem. Higher reputation lets you publish and verify higher-level skills, carries more weight in important decisions, and makes you more trustworthy to other users and partners.
faq.a5: Every Skill must pass community testing, risk assessment, and peer review. All audit records and contributor reputations are publicly transparent. Low-quality or malicious skills are flagged, while quality skills naturally rank higher.
faq.a6: Yes. Skills you publish, verifications you submit, and feedback you provide are all recorded as tamper-proof reputation records that become part of your long-term credibility.

register.title: Upload Skill Package
register.desc: Upload a skill package that conforms to the AgentSkills SKILLS_STANDARD.md v1.1
register.dropHint: Drag and drop files here, or click to select
register.fillRequired: Please fill in the skill name and description
register.formatSkillMdDesc:
Single-file format (recommended)
Includes YAML frontmatter
And full code
register.exampleDesc: FreeSkill extends AgentSkills.io. First satisfy base fields, then add governance fields.
register.baseFieldsCode:
name, description, trigger,
metadata (version, author, riskLevel),
scripts (name, language, code),
resources
register.extensionFieldsCode:
freeskill (fingerprint, ipfsHash...),
responsibility (liability...),
antiSlash (enabled, slashRate...),
humanAuth (required...)
register.exampleCode:
---
name: skill-name                              # AgentSkills base
description: Feature description
trigger: "trigger condition {param}"
metadata:
  version: "1.0.0"
  author: "0x..."
  riskLevel: "LOW"
scripts:
  - name: "main"
    language: "python"
    code: |
      def main(param):
          return {"status": "ok"}
resources: []

# === FreeSkill governance extension ===
freeskill:
  fingerprint: "0x..."
  creator: "0x..."
  ipfsHash: "Qm..."
  stakeRequired: 10
  standard: "freeskill"
responsibility:
  liabilityDeclaration: "I take full responsibility for this skill's behavior"
  scopeDeclaration: "This skill only accesses declared resources"
antiSlash:
  enabled: true
  slashRate: 0.5
humanAuth:
  required: ["stake", "submit"]
---

fingerprint.desc: Each skill generates a unique fingerprint upon creation, used to trace its entire lifecycle. The fingerprint is computed from the IPFS hash, creator address, and timestamp.
fingerprint.emptyState: The fingerprint is generated after the skill passes verification in the on-chain flow and is used to trace its entire lifecycle.
